# Warcraft Exports — Historical Reproduction Military Gear & Uniforms

> Manufacturer-direct global exporter of museum-grade WW1 & WW2 historical reproduction military uniforms, jackets, helmets, leather holsters, canvas webbing, rifle slings, and militaria accessories. Based in Kanpur, India.

Warcraft Exports (RAAS Enterprises) is a primary manufacturer specializing in highly authentic WWI and WWII reproduction military gear, uniforms, and equipment. We supply historical reenactment clubs, living history units, film production costume departments, museum gift shops, and collectors across 20+ countries.

---

## 🎖️ Flagship Uniforms & Apparel Collection

Warcraft Exports is a premier manufacturer of WW1 and WW2 military uniforms and historical clothing:

- **WW2 German Uniforms & Camouflage**: German Wehrmacht WW2 uniforms, M43 field jackets, SS camouflage smocks, Zeltbahn patterns, M40/M43 caps, Fallschirmjäger boots & paratrooper gear.
- **US Army & USMC WW2 Uniforms**: US M1941 (M41) & M1943 (M43) field jackets, US Navy (USN) N-1 deck jackets, HBT fatigue uniforms, USMC P41 fatigues, garrison caps, and M1 helmet liners.
- **British Commonwealth WW1 & WW2 Uniforms**: British 1937 pattern battledress jackets & trousers, WW1 tunic uniforms, Tommy officer tunics, and Brodie helmet accessories.
- **Soviet Red Army WW2 Uniforms**: Gymnasterka tunics, Sharovari trousers, & winter padded Telogreika jackets.
- **Military Footwear, Legwear & Headgear**: German jackboots, Officer service boots, WW1 wool puttees (British Army / US Doughboy puttees), WW1/WW2 canvas leggings & gaiters, M1 Helmets, M1917A1 helmets & helmet liners, German M16/M35/M40/M42 Stahlhelm replicas, WW1 French Adrian & British Brodie helmets, M38 paratrooper helmets, and garrison side caps.

---

## 🎒 Holsters, Slings, Pouches & Reenactment Equipment

- **Leather Holsters**: Luger P08 hard/soft shell holsters, M1916 Colt .45 holsters, Walther PPK/PPKS holsters, P38 holsters, M7 shoulder holsters, Browning Hi-Power leather holsters, and Revolver holsters.
- **Rifle Slings**: British WW2 Enfield slings, M1 Garand leather & web slings, Mauser G98 / K98 leather slings, Mosin Nagant slings with escutcheons, M14 slings, M1 Carbine slings, USGI web slings, and Ruger American rifle slings.
- **Ammunition & Mag Pouches**: M1910 1st aid pouches, MP40 double/triple magazine pouches, 1911 double mag pouches, M1 Carbine stock/belt pouches, Thompson mag pouches, STG-44 magazine pouches, shotgun shell pouches, and 5.56 mag pouches for battle belts.
- **Canvas & Webbing Equipment**: M1936 musette bags (WWII US Army), German bread bags, M1928 haversacks, WW2 British kit bags, pistol belts, canteens & covers, bayonet frogs, and trench knives.

## 🏛️ Wholesale, B2B & Film Prop Outfitting

- **[Wholesale Enquiry Portal](/wholesale)**: Direct bulk purchasing for reenactment clubs, theater shows, TV/Film costume directors, museum gift shops, and retail militaria stores.
- **Manufacturer Direct**: Factory-direct pricing from Kanpur, India with flexible Minimum Order Quantities (MOQs starting at 100 units).
- **Competitor Alternative**: High-quality, cost-effective manufacturer alternative to IMA USA, World War Supply, At The Front, and Epic Militaria.
